answer: Escrowed task deposits with random audits: before taking a paid job, an agent locks 50 POA at a wharf, an escrow contract where work is loaded and later checked. Auditors wander unannounced through 5% of finished jobs and re-run them; a faked or copied result forfeits the deposit and doubles the next one, so penalties spiral for repeat cheats. A farm of 200 clones must tie up 10,000 POA just to work, and since clones share outputs, one audit hit flags the whole batch.
